source_note: Soundgas studio top-down cut-out of TR-808 SN 228285 (2400x1484 px, reference only, (c) Soundgas). Cross-checked on commons_tr808_mim_pocius_cropped.jpg (CC BY 2.0, Bryan Pocius) and soundgas/rc20_...SN051874-2.jpg, both mapped onto the master with a SIFT homography (rms 1.0 / 0.9 px).
origin: top-left (rear-left) corner of the 508 x 305 mm top view; x right, y towards the player (down on screen)

frame.mapping: master px = (95.5, 77) + 4.338 * (c + R(+0.0015 rad) * (p - c)), c = (254, 152.5) mm. Without the rotation this is the x_mm=(x-95.5)/4.338, y_mm=(y-77)/4.338 frame of panel-notes.md; the 0.086 deg turn levels the rules and the outline (both slope 0.0015 in the photo), it moves nothing by more than 0.4 mm.
frame.true_scale_note: The 508 x 305 frame follows the owner's manual / service-notes spec. The PCB artwork says the real panel is ~5 % smaller: pot pitch on the main board (SN p. 11, scaled by its 42-pin CPU footprint, 2.54 mm pitch) and the step-switch pitch on the switch board (SN p. 10, scaled by its FHI-12S-2.54DS connector) both give 0.946 x these coordinates (similarity fit of 15 knob centres to the p. 11 pots: 0.9457, rms 0.36 mm; key pitch 17.94 mm on p. 10 against 18.96 mm here: 0.946), i.e. a real width of ~481 mm, which matches the museum measurement of 19 in (The Henry Ford, 482.6 mm). Multiply by true_mm_factor for physical millimetres; proportions are unaffected.

panel.note: official 508 (W) x 305 (D) x 105 (H) mm, 5 kg (owner's manual p. 22; service notes p. 1 say 110 mm high). The master outline is 2203.5 x 1322 px = 508 x 305 at 4.338 px/mm (aspect 1.6668 vs 1.6656). See frame.true_scale_note.

accuracy: printed features +-0.3 mm relative to each other (three photos agree to 0.1-0.3 mm after a projective map), +-0.5 mm absolute in the 508-mm frame; knob, switch and dial centres +-0.2-0.3 mm (fitted to printed tick rings / dots); key, knob and cap 3-D sizes +-1 mm; rear panel +-2 mm

fonts.panel_legends: Helvetica Medium caps (LEVEL, TONE, TEMPO, PRE-SCALE, MASTER VOLUME...). The cream mode-block legends (PATTERN WRITE, INSTRUMENT-SELECT, STEP NUMBER...) and the orange PLAY / COM-POSE / TRACK CLEAR read as Helvetica Bold.
fonts.ordinals: "1st", "2nd" keep lowercase ordinals at the same cap height as PART.
fonts.plates: medium grotesque small caps on the cream plates: code letters full capitals (cap_h_large ~4.0 mm), the rest small capitals (cap_h_small ~1.95 mm), one baseline; "Cls'd" keeps its apostrophe. Spans give the exact split.
fonts.digits: large number-bar digits 1-12 / 1-4: Helvetica Medium/Regular figures ~5.6 mm tall, dark; step numbers 1-16 above the keys: Helvetica Bold, white, ~3.1 mm; TEMPO dial digits: Helvetica figures ~2.95 mm, upright.
fonts.logos: Brand marks (roland, rhythm_composer, tr808, computer_controlled) are slots only and are never drawn from the photos; each is an artwork place (artwork/tr808/maker, name, model, tagline in the ROM folder) or an older pack's mark. The orange rule under Rhythm Composer has with_logo: true.

conventions.text: bbox = ink bounding box (cap height to baseline for caps-only legends; descenders included where present); x,y = bbox centre; cap_h = capital height
conventions.outline_box: bbox = outer edge of the keyline; stroke = keyline width
conventions.line: points = stroke centre line; stroke = width
conventions.knob: x,y = centre of the printed scale (= shaft); d = printed scale outer diameter; knob_d = knob body seen from above; cap_d = coloured insert or cap top
conventions.rotary_switch: x,y = shaft centre; positions[].angle_deg from 12 o'clock, clockwise positive; dot = printed position dot
conventions.key: x,y,w,h = visible top face centred on its panel cut-out (photo parallax removed); cutout_bbox where measured
conventions.param: interactive elements carry a param hint for the plug-in

rear_panel.source: private/tr808/docs/photos/soundgas/mintboxed_Roland-TR-808-Rhythm-Composer-SN228285-Mint-12.jpg (straight-on rear view, 2400x559); legends cross-checked with vse/vse_roland_tr808_rear_lg.jpg and the owner's manual p. 2 drawing
rear_panel.note: Seen from behind, so left and right are swapped: x is given in TOP-PANEL coordinates (mm from the left side as seen from the front, 508-mm frame). Scale ~4.34 px/mm from the face width; accuracy +-2 mm. The rear face is black; legends are light grey; each group sits in a ruled box with its title on top. All jacks are 6.3 mm mono with chrome nuts (SG7622). Only the jack tops peek over the rear edge in top-down photos. The power cord leaves underneath on the player's left (the right as seen from behind); the rating plate is underneath.

layout.note: from the straight-on rear photo (Mint-12), 4.34 px/mm; y in mm down from the rear face's top edge, box_x and face_x in the view's mm from its left (seen from behind)

ui_suggestions.note: START/STOP and TAP caps exist in two finishes (orange-amber on SN 228285 / 051874 / 051878, pale cream with a translucent gold edge on others): offer key_startstop_amber / key_startstop_cream as a theme choice. Keys 13-16 are cream on most units, white on some.

All positions are panel-plane (shaft / cut-out) positions. In the photos the knob tops lean outwards from about (254, 153) mm by up to 6 mm and the key tops by up to 3.7 mm; draw raised parts centred on their elements, optionally with a small fixed light-direction offset for the 3-D look.
Under the knobs the photos hide the MODE PATTERN CLEAR dot and the MASTER VOLUME 8/9 dots; they are computed from the fitted circles. Draw them; the knob covers them in practice.
POWER is a mains push switch on the real unit; in a plug-in it is decoration (or a bypass/sleep toggle at most).
